# The Realty Bazaar

> The Realty Bazaar is India's leading PropTech platform for real-estate brokers and a verified property discovery marketplace. It provides a mobile-first CRM with automated social marketing, AI copy generation, Meta Ads lead generation, and direct client communication for Indian brokers.

## Core Platform

- [Home Page](https://therealtybazaar.com/): Public property discovery engine and platform introduction.
- [Property Marketplace](https://therealtybazaar.com/properties): Real-time searchable catalogue of verified residential apartments, independent villas, commercial spaces, and plots for sale and rent across India (Surat, Ahmedabad, Mumbai, Vadodara, Pune, Bengaluru).
- [For Brokers](https://therealtybazaar.com/for-brokers): Dedicated overview for real estate professionals on how the mobile app manages property uploads, social marketing, lead capture, and CRM workflows.
- [Features](https://therealtybazaar.com/features): Comprehensive feature breakdown including AI content creation, Instagram/Facebook auto-publishing, Meta Ads management, and mobile pipeline tracking.
- [Pricing & Subscription Plans](https://therealtybazaar.com/pricing): Transparent pricing tiers (Starter, Standard, Premium) for individual agents and real estate brokerage agencies.
- [How It Works](https://therealtybazaar.com/how-it-works): Step-by-step dual workflow for brokers managing listings and property seekers finding homes.

## Key Features & Capabilities

- **Mobile-First Real Estate CRM**: Manage inventory, leads, site visits, follow-up reminders, and deals on iOS and Android.
- **Automated Social Publishing**: One-tap publishing of property media, AI captions, and hashtags directly to Instagram and Facebook.
- **Managed Paid Advertising**: Automated Meta Ads campaigns targeting active local property buyers with cost-per-lead optimization.
- **Direct Buyer-Broker Connectivity**: Property seekers connect directly with listing brokers via Phone and WhatsApp with zero intermediary fees.
- **Public Property Marketplace**: Automatically showcases active broker inventory with structured data and rich SEO for organic search discovery.
